# CSS Forge

> CSS Forge is a zero-runtime design-token generator for modern CSS systems.

Use the smallest relevant document for the task.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](/guide/getting-started): installation and first configuration
- [Configuration](/guide/configuration): config structure and token references
- [Using CSS Forge](/guide/usage): CLI and programmatic API
- [Colors](/tokens/colors): palettes, gradients, and themes
- [Spacing](/tokens/spacing): custom and fluid spacing
- [Typography](/tokens/typography): custom and fluid type scales
- [Primitives](/tokens/primitives): arbitrary design tokens
- [Examples](/guide/examples): framework integrations
- [Agent guide](/agents): task routing and repository sources of truth

- [Package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hebilicious/cssforge/refs/heads/main/packages/cssforge/README.md)

- [Configuration types](https://github.com/Hebilicious/cssforge/blob/main/packages/cssforge/src/config.ts)
- [CLI implementation](https://github.com/Hebilicious/cssforge/blob/main/packages/cssforge/src/cli.ts)
